name: record_screen
title: Record screen: three pages, the input meter / master follow `mon`, the radio's `radio` report; nothing is recorded or saved

steps.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)

steps.say: the input meters: `mon` routes the line input through the engine into MAIN and CUE

steps.note: (soft: the line input shows in the IN L meter once it carries anything: a tone, or its own noise)
(soft: needs a signal on the LINE IN: connect a source for this one)

steps.say: the pages RESAMPLE and RADIO: the screens come up; the radio chip answers `radio`

steps.note: the driver's text and the pins' levels

steps.say: no take is armed or saved here: F1, Rec, F3 and F7 are never pressed

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
